blocks.text: ATLANTA— Giannis Antetokounmpo had 24 points and 18 rebounds in his first victory with the Heat, leading Miami over the Atlanta Hawks 129-117 in the NBA on Wednesday night. Bam Adebayo also had 24 points and grabbed nine rebounds for the Heat, who lost their first four games after acquiring Antetokounmpo from Milwaukee in the offseason. Adebayo passed Udonis Haslem to become the Heat’s career leader in rebounds.
